name: independent-after-restore
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: Existing accounts sign in and the records are all present (after-restore)
steps.actual: The Administrator created before the change signed in with the same password. All 3 Contracts (#1, #2, #3) and 1 Matter(s) are present with their original titles.

steps.action: Document Version bytes match the pre-change hashes (after-restore)
steps.actual: Downloaded 4 Document Versions (1/original, 1/later, 2/original, 2/later) and every SHA-256 matched the value recorded on the earlier build.

steps.action: The Contributor keeps exactly its earlier reach (after-restore)
steps.actual: The Contributor signed in and still reads member Contract 1 (HTTP 200) while the Confidential Contract 3 still answers HTTP 404, the same reach as before the change.

steps.action: The saved encrypted relay is actually usable (after-restore)
steps.actual: The relay saved on the earlier build still reads as source "app" and a test message actually arrived in this instance's own Mailpit (0 → 1). A stored secret that can be decrypted and used is the proof, not a flag saying one exists.

steps.action: A new upload processes on the changed instance (after-restore)
steps.actual: A new Contract and PDF were created on the changed instance: the worker took the Version to "ready" and the download matched the uploaded bytes, so writes and processing work after the change.
